label: CI/model result of pcb/board_gen.py in kicad/kicad:10.0.7; not a hardware PASS; bench gates OPEN

layers.source: W2 PWRB-R layers6 study and W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6: 6 layers JLC06161H-2116 1.6 mm, the stackup of the 6-layer CTRL (W2 CTRL-R / CTRL-4; pcb/generated/stackup-6l.json from pcb/stackup.py, jlcpcb.com/impedance read 2026-11-12), ordered with finished outer copper 2 oz and inner 0.5 oz (copper_option outer_2oz, jlcpcb.com read 2026-11-13): the power classes take their 2 oz outer widths (PWR1A 0.2 mm). 1.6 mm is the order thickness; the contract gives PWR_B its own stackup (mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json PWR_B stackup: t 1.664 MODEL with 2 oz outer, 6 layers, order 1.6 +/- 10 %, W2 MECH-8), which the mechanics use
layers.types_why: S-G-S-S-P-S as the 6-layer CTRL: In1.Cu (L2) a solid GND plane 0.2234 mm under F.Cu, so the LAB5 trunk, the TPS2553 switches, the Kelvin shunts and the LNA bias filters (XAL5030 inductors, dampers) on F.Cu keep a solid return plane directly below; In4.Cu (L5) a solid 3V3_Q6A plane (the 20-pad monitor supply that crosses from the bar to the arm), both typed power so Freerouting routes no trace on them. In2.Cu (L3) and In3.Cu (L4) are the routing layers the stackup adds; every routing layer faces a plane (F.Cu-L2 0.2234 mm, L3-L2 0.3 mm, L4-L5 0.3 mm, B.Cu-L5 0.2234 mm). The power classes route on F.Cu/B.Cu only (router.class_layers): inner copper is 0.5 oz (PWR1A would need 1.8 mm there, netclasses.json inner_min_width_mm); W2 PWR-L6-PLACE fourth pass, combined: the PWR1A sub-class PWR05A (stackup-6l.json inner_classes, nets limited to <=0.339 A / <=0.499 A) routes on all four routing layers, 0.5 mm on In2.Cu/In3.Cu

plan.F.Cu: L1: parts (top side only), LAB5 trunk and Kelvin copper, power and signal routes, GND pour
plan.In1.Cu: L2: solid GND plane (pre-route zone, layer type power: the router puts only vias through it)
plan.In2.Cu: L3: signal routes and the PWR05A power sub-class at 0.5 mm (no other power class), no pour (W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6; W2 PWR-L6-PLACE fourth pass, combined)
plan.In3.Cu: L4: signal routes and the PWR05A power sub-class at 0.5 mm (no other power class), no pour (W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6; W2 PWR-L6-PLACE fourth pass, combined)
plan.In4.Cu: L5: solid 3V3_Q6A plane (pre-route zone, layer type power); every SMD 3V3_Q6A pad has a scripted via
plan.B.Cu: L6: B2B half J209 (bottom), its GND spine and contact escapes, LAB5 stubs, power and signal routes, GND pour

planned_cutouts.note: rule areas (spec blocks) on the spec layers; DRC reports copper inside one, pcb/check_boards.py planned_cutouts measures every copper item against the rects
